text:
Asha (PM): quick sync — post-launch backlog is noisy. need to decide iteration focus: customer blockers vs polish. propose a 30m triage tomorrow 10am PT to split into hotfix lane + micro-polish. thoughts?
Diego (Eng): +1. can you paste top customer-facing bugs so we can score them?
Priya (Support): pasting top signals from support/helpdesk (counts are rough):
1) embeddings API timeouts (100+ orgs, intermittent)
2) streaming dropouts on long sessions (~20 reported)
3) billing invoice mismatch (5 orgs, high severity)
4) console duplicate entries on import (dozen)
5) onboarding copy typo (lots of small asks)
6) reranker tail latency spikes (sporadic, large requests)
Priya (Support): also customers asking for clearer error CTA and retry UX.
Mira (SWE): proposed triage rubric (short): sev (1-3), customers (S/M/L), regression (y/n), effort (1-5). compute a simple score to rank.
Mira (SWE): code snippet:```
# priority score (higher -> more urgent)
score = sev*3 + customers*2 + (5 if regression else 0) - effort
```
Sam (Designer): UX polish list: onboarding typo, help text clarity, better retry CTA. most are 1-2d. we can bundle as a micro-polish sprint if we separate them from infra work.
Diego (Eng): reranker latency looks infra-y (fallback thrash). if score says high we should canary a kernel fallback change. I can own a quick canary.
Asha (PM): decision proposal for the groom: two lanes —
• urgent fixes: score >= 8 -> immediate sprint ticket + canary plan
• micro-polish: effort <= 3 and low customer count -> bundle as 'micro-polish' with a single owner
Asha (PM): owners to propose now: Diego -> reranker/latency, Mira -> streaming dropouts, Sam -> UX micro-polish, Priya -> validate repros and customer notes.
Priya (Support): I can confirm repro steps and affected org list by EOD.
Diego (Eng): ack. I'll prep a short canary runbook (steps + rollback) before groom.
Mira (SWE): I'll prepare repro + logs for streaming, include sample session ids.
Sam (Designer): will draft CTA copy variations and a tiny QA checklist.
Asha (PM): I'll create tickets with labels: `iteration:wave-1`, `lane:urgent` or `lane:micro-polish`, and link them in the groom doc.
Asha (PM): also propose acceptance criteria for hotfixes: reproduction steps, perf regression <5% on baseline, deploy canary to 10% of traffic then ramp.
Diego (Eng): sounds good. can we add an SLA rollback condition? eg. if error rate > 1% or latency regresses >15% -> rollback.
Asha (PM): agreed. adding as `deploy-guard` in ticket checklist.
ReleaseBot: Meeting created: "Iteration grooming — hotfix vs micro-polish" tomorrow 10:00 PT. calendar link: https://calendar.company/evt/3187654321
Priya (Support): :thumbsup: I'll send affected orgs doc into the meeting thread.
Mira (SWE): I'll attach logs and minimal repro script.
Diego (Eng): prepping canary steps.
Sam (Designer): will wireframe the CTA in Figma and post link.
Asha (PM): perfect. if anyone sees a re-score between now and groom, update the ticket. see you tomorrow. :yay:
Priya (Support): ack
Diego (Eng): ack
Mira (SWE): ack
Sam (Designer): ack
